identity.name: Suspicious Process Spawned by wininit.exe
identity.summary: An attacker spawns a malicious process from wininit.exe to evade detection, mimicking a legitimate Windows system process. Cortex should detect this abnormal process spawning behavior.

biocs.name: Suspicious Process Spawned by wininit.exe
biocs.description: Detection of a process spawned by wininit.exe, which is typically not a legitimate parent for arbitrary processes.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wininit.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe' and action_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
